Question: Is 16 LPA a good salary to live in Bangalore?
Answer: I have spent almost 7 years in Bangalore. 2013–2020. 4 years as a college student. 3 years as an entry-level IT professional. While in college I used to get monthly pocket money of around 6k. That used to be enough for me. I lived in a 2BHK apartment at BTM 2nd stage and shared it with 3 of my college mates. Used to party/go for semi-fancy dinner once in a while. Had a cook at home. Used to frequently go out for dinner/lunch. Used public transport mostly and cabs once a while. Also used to save around 500-1k per month. Life in Bangalore was manageable. Fast forward 4 years. Now I was getting 25k in hand. Shared a decent PG with 3 other colleagues. Used to stay near the office to reduce travel time and cost. Used to have food outside every now and then. Used to party/go for semi-fancy dinner once in a while. Used public transport mostly and cabs once a while. Saved over 10K per month. Life in Bangalore was manageable then too. So what can we infer from this story? Is your 16LPA salary good enough for Bangalore? You are to decide that. Are you staying alone or staying with your family? Are you staying in a posh area or could manage to live in outskirts. Do you have any liabilities like a home loan or car loan? Are your parents or anyone else dependent on you? Do you prefer to travel by public transport or private vehicle? How often do you like to party and go out? How expensive is your taste in things? You have to answer these questions and decide for yourself. Open an excel sheet and list out all your needs, wants, and investments, and decide for yourself if you can afford your lifestyle. I hope I could give you some clarity :)
